name: chrisgve-workspace-qdrant-mcp
description: Project-scoped semantic workspace memory for AI coding assistants. Watches your project files, auto-indexes code and docs into Qdrant with tree-sitter semantic chunking, LSP integration, and hybrid search (dense + sparse + RRF). 6 MCP tools: store, search, retrieve, grep, list, rules. **Alpha** — testers and feedback welcome.
